note: Iowa DNR state park east of Muscatine known for its sandstone bluffs, trails and the 1848 Pine Creek Grist Mill. Non-modern wooded campground: grass pads with 32-ft back-in driveways (fits a 23-ft rig). --Claude
summary: RA site list confirms 20 non-electric sites with 32-ft back-in driveways plus a hike-in youth group site; $10 off-peak / $14 peak; water and vault toilets, no electric or showers; open year round with water off mid-Oct to ~May. Stored pin is ~400 m ESE of the campground loop, in the woods.
flags: PIN: stored 41.46778,-90.88111 is the facility point RA publishes for the whole park ('GPS Info. 41.46778, -90.88111') and falls in unbroken woods. The campground loop (matching the DNR's 12/2025 campground map: a diagonal SW-NE road with the loop branching east and the youth site at its NE end; picnic tables visible on leaf-off Esri) is at ~41.4687,-90.8857, ~400 m WNW. Re-pin there. The paved lot ~170 m NE of the loop is the Upper Picnic Area.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Pine Creek runs through the eastern and northern part of the park, roughly 400 m or more from the loop and below the bluffs, with woods between; RA tags every site 'Near Water - no'.

BOOKING: the state:IA policy row covers it; RA says '100 percent reservable and accepts reservations year round until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival' and 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance', consistent with the row. Stored fcfs 'never' kept.
